description: This file manages radio traffic data harvesting, including fetching radio interface data, managing harvesting status, and periodic reporting with threading and synchronization.

classes.name: struct radiotrafficdata
classes.description: Data structure holding radio traffic statistics and metadata.

methods.name: isvalueinRISarray
methods.description: Checks if a value exists in an array of ULONGs.

methods.name: SetRISHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Enables or disables radio traffic harvesting and manages thread lifecycle.

methods.name: GetRISHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Returns current harvesting status.

methods.name: SetRISReportingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the reporting period and updates TTL accordingly.

methods.name: GetRISReportingPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the current reporting period.

methods.name: SetRISPollingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the polling period and signals the harvesting thread.

methods.name: ValidateRISPeriod
methods.description: Validates if a given period is within allowed values.

methods.name: GetRISPollingPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the current polling period.

methods.name: SetRISReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets default reporting period.

methods.name: GetRISReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Gets default reporting period.

methods.name: SetRISPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets default polling period.

methods.name: GetRISPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Gets default polling period.

methods.name: GetRISOverrideTTL
methods.description: Retrieves the current TTL override value.

methods.name: SetRISOverrideTTL
methods.description: Sets the TTL override value.

methods.name: GetRISOverrideTTLDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the default TTL override value.

methods.name: _rtsyscmd
methods.description: Reads command output into buffer from a FILE pointer.

methods.name: getRadioBssid
methods.description: Fetches the BSSID of a radio interface based on index.

methods.name: add_to_rt_list
methods.description: Adds radio traffic data to internal list.

methods.name: print_rt_list
methods.description: Prints current radio traffic list for debugging.

methods.name: delete_rt_list
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for radio traffic list.

methods.name: GetRadioTrafficData
methods.description: Fetches radio interface data and updates list.

methods.name: StartRadioTrafficHarvesting
methods.description: Thread function to periodically harvest radio traffic data.
